lead_records_per_line: forge-gpu-run exit, the inner timeout exit (124 = timeout, never a pass), the run log's sha256 (L45)
exit_semantics: gate 3 = refused before the lease (module sha or write-once path); forge-gpu-run 75/76 = no window or lease (nothing ran); 124 = timeout; step 0 = completed, verdict from scripts/bwdf2_gpu_post.py; a G4 step exits 0 at once when its series is complete
rlimit_as: none set (L114); the lead runs each line in a scope with MemoryMax=12G, OOMPolicy=continue
post_device_followups_cpu: python3 -B -P scripts/bwdf2_gpu_post.py line <line>   (each non-G4 line -> artifacts/bwdf1/f2/gpu/<line>.post.json)
python3 -B -P scripts/bwdf2_gpu_post.py controls       (accepted results, Build B vs Build F2 bitwise)
python3 -B -P scripts/bwdf2_gpu_post.py g4             (K3 GPU per-ID, B vs F2)
copied_audit_scripts: artifacts/bwdf1/f2/gpu_lines/<arm>/f01_halfprec_zero_inner.py and f03_zero_batch.py are BWD-F1's copies with three lines changed (the held-lease check; ROOT one level deeper; OUT under artifacts/bwdf1/f2/gpu/); aud1_verdicts.py is byte-identical; aud1_gpu_load.py keeps the audit's API with the module pin set to Build B / F2
